## History

Cyril Lisle quit university two years prior to travel overseas with his mother due to her declining health. He later met [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in a park during a rainstorm, sheltering her and subsequently sending her roses and a poem to pursue a romantic relationship. After taking [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to a college reception and arranging an awkward visit between his family and hers, Cyril proposed to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in a pavilion by the shore as she was preparing to leave [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). However, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) realized she did not love him and turned down his proposal, ending their relationship.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P27](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0027), [v3 ch.Charming P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036), [v3 ch.Charming P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 ch.Charming P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 ch.Charming P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 ch.Rowena P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), +11 more_

## Relationships

### [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cyril-lisle--dorothy.md)

[Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) is Cyril's sister, who visits [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) alongside the rest of the Lisle family a day earlier than expected. During this chaotic and awkward family gathering, [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) distinguishes herself by connecting warmly with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), +3 more_

- Sibling of — sister  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 ch.Weddings P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)</sub>

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cyril-lisle--nell-harcourt.md)

Cyril and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) were mutually infatuated and widely expected to marry, accompanying each other to social events like the [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college) reception. Cyril arranged for his family to visit [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), and he gave her gifts and flowers for her graduation, though she ultimately favored another suitor's tokens. Their romance came to an abrupt end when Cyril proposed to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in a shore pavilion, leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to realize she did not truly love him and reject his offer, leaving both of them to mourn the broken relationship.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Rowena P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Rowena P4](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0004), [v3 ch.Rowena P6](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0006), +20 more_

- Romantically involved with — infatuated with each other and expected to marry  <sub>[v3 ch.Rowena P4](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0004), [v3 ch.Confidences P35](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0035), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), +1 more</sub>
